title: rhododendron hirsutum f. microphyllum
intro: Rhododendron hirsutum f. microphyllum, commonly known as the dwarf alpine rhododendron, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron hirsutum f. microphyllum include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral properties, making it a potential treatment for infections and other illnesses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
